decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on fruit puree is close to the core offer and has public recognition, so dropping it would discard visible success and earlier investment.
The firm presented the Abendbrotkäse on its home page as a flagship of its direction, so the public commitment and the need to justify the launch strongly favor keeping it.
The semi-hard cheese wheel is close to the established cheese business and needs little extra investment, and any weak results can still be attributed to a short time on the market.
The spicy cheese is a line with several models, which reflects substantial investment that management would be reluctant to write off after only one year.
The mild soft cheese was publicly announced as part of the new range, so the visible commitment and the short time on the market argue for persisting.
The washed-rind soft cheese has the least visible commitment and is a niche product, so it is the most likely to be cut, but one year is too short to rule out temporary causes for any disappointment.
